summary: infogram-bot ships a Telegram-driven remote shell with full host RCE and file exfiltration
details: The package registers a Telegram MessageHandler in handlers.py whose callback forwards incoming Telegram message text into subprocess.check_output(cmd, shell=True, cwd=_c.cwd, timeout=120) via core.run_cmd, exposing the installer's host to arbitrary shell command execution driven by the Telegram Bot API. Additional handlers implement '.py' / '.exec' / '.sh' subcommands, a 'get all' file-exfiltration path that uploads local files as Telegram documents, and a '.printenv' environment dump. The '.sh <cmd>' branch in group and supergroup chats executes subprocess.check_output with shell=True before the owner-ID check, so any participant in a group the bot joins can run shell commands on the installer's host without being on the configured owner list. Effect on any host that runs this bot is full remote-code-execution controlled by a remote Telegram party plus arbitrary file exfiltration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
